item: NYS A09370A good cause eviction technical amendments (Rosenthal; same as S8612-A)
status_checked: Last action I could see: 05/28/2026 reported referred to rules. Passage/signature NOT confirmed.
section_paragraph: Sec 26-301.1(e) Exemption from certain conversion requirements (new para (5))
proposed_redline: ADD (5) **Units in a subsidized limited-equity cooperative that are occupied by non-purchasing tenants shall remain subject to the protections of article 6-A of the real property law until the tenancy ends or the unit is purchased under the plan; nothing in this section shall be construed to treat an offering plan as consummated for purposes of subdivision 7 of section 214 of the real property law before the transfer of title and issuance of shares to at least one subscriber.**
rationale: A09370A defines consummated (title transfer plus shares and proprietary lease to at least one subscriber) and limits the co-op exemption to consummated plans. After consummation the exemption applies; non-purchasing renters could lose good cause protection unless the local law or covenant supplies it.
verification_notes: Bill text read in full. Cite-check against enacted RPL 211/214 and GBL art. 23-A before drafting final. Check whether A09370A/S8612-A passed or was signed.

item: NYS A09370A regulated-housing exemption limited to units with no-cause termination protection
section_paragraph: Sec 26-1807(a) Affordability covenants (add new para (6)); Sec 26-1804(c)(1)
current_text: (a)(1) Minimum affordability period of 30 years; ... (5) Anti-speculation provisions preventing windfall profits.
proposed_redline: ADD (6) **Protection against termination or non-renewal of tenancy without cause for all non-owner occupants of the cooperative's units; such protection shall be stated in each lease and in the recorded covenant.**
rationale: Under proposed 214(6) a unit restricted by regulatory agreement is exempt from good cause only to the extent that agreement requires no-cause protection. Without a clause the covenant could leave a protection gap.
verification_notes: Bill text read. Confirm interaction with HPD regulatory agreements and article XI exemptions before finalizing.

item: NYS A09370A lease-notice window 30-90 days becomes 30-100 days; notice exemption for regulated units with a lease that states governing law
current_text: During conversion processes all tenants shall retain their rights under applicable rent regulation lease protections and anti-harassment laws.
proposed_redline: ADD after 'anti-harassment laws': **including article 6-A of the real property law where applicable. Leases for units in cooperatives exempt under subdivision 5 or 6 of section 214 shall state the governing law and that good cause is required for termination or non-renewal.**
rationale: Aligns with proposed 226-c(1)(a) and 231-c(2) so exempt units are not left without notice or lease language.
verification_notes: Redline is a conforming clause; no change needed to the 90-day TOPA response period in Sec 26-1904 (different statute).

item: NYS A09370A chronic nonpayment of rent as a ground for non-renewal
section_paragraph: Sec 26-1805(b) and 26-1809(c) (carrying charges and subsidy continuation)
current_text: (b) The department may adjust these allocations ... provided that tenant households maintain stable housing and do not experience increased out-of-pocket costs.
proposed_redline: ADD (c) **Where a participating household is subject to a nonpayment or chronic nonpayment claim arising from a delay in subsidy payment or conversion allocation
rationale: the department shall issue a written payment confirmation within 10 days of request and such delay shall not constitute nonpayment by the tenant.**
verification_notes: Bill makes chronic nonpayment a non-renewal ground with no right to cure. Subsidy conversion timing could create arrears that are not the tenant's fault.
column13: Policy design clause not in the bill. Needs housing-court counsel review.
